# Dr. Murshidul Arefin — Hepatobiliary, Pancreatic & Liver Surgeon, Dhaka

> Patient-friendly hepatobiliary, pancreatic, and liver surgical care by Dr. Murshidul Arefin at Popular Medical College Hospital, Dhanmondi, Dhaka, Bangladesh. Specialising in liver, gallbladder, biliary tract, pancreas, and upper GI surgery — open and laparoscopic.

Dr. Murshidul Arefin (MBBS, MS Hepatobiliary Surgery, BSMMU) is a senior hepatobiliary, pancreatic, and liver surgeon based in Dhaka. The site documents his surgical services, treatments, patient education, mentorship, articles, and contact details.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Dr. Arefin's hepatobiliary surgical practice in Dhaka.

- [Pancreatic Cyst Surgery, Dhaka](/treatment/pancreatic-cyst-surgery-dhaka/): Surgery for IPMN, MCN, and other pancreatic cysts.
